# Intentionally non-ASCII fixture.

This file exists so the tests can prove three things at once:

1. The ASCII guard skips paths declared in its UNICODE_ALLOWED_PREFIXES list,
   and only those paths.
2. The product stores and returns real Unicode business data faithfully: Igbo
   names, the dotted product name, Pidgin phrasing and an emoji a trader might
   actually type into a customer note.
3. The engineering-artifact rule and the runtime-data rule are genuinely
   different rules, not one rule with an exception bolted on.

Every line below is customer data, never code, never a log message.

AHỊA
Emeka Ọkọnkwo
Ngozi Ụzọma
Chinedu Nwachukwu
Oga, how much be this one?
Na 45k last price.
Customer note: bring am tomorrow morning.
Customer note with emoji: thanks o 🙏
Storefront banner text: AHỊA — Alaba Electronics
